name: ios-shell
title: Native SwiftUI chrome around Compose screens (Liquid Glass on iOS 26)
postInstall: 1. Add the two .swift files to the Xcode target.
Open the project in Xcode, drag LamintraShell.swift and
ComposeScreen.swift into the app group, and tick your app target.
Editing the .pbxproj from a CLI is how project files get corrupted,
so this one is left to Xcode.
2. Point your existing App at the shell.
The Compose Multiplatform template ships an @main App already, and a
second @main does not compile - so LamintraShell is a plain View.
In iOSApp.swift, replace the body of the WindowGroup:
Then build from Xcode. Compose renders inside each tab; SwiftUI draws
the tab bar and the navigation bars, which is what makes iOS 26 apply
Liquid Glass to them without any styling code.
